newsitem.title: SAO TOME AND PRINCIPE: Sao Tome doubles fuel prices.
newsitem.headline: Sao Tome doubles fuel prices.

text.p: The government of Sao Tome and Principe said on Monday it was doubling fuel prices in the African island state to comply with World Bank recommendations.
Petrol prices will rise to $0.64 from $0.27 per litre while diesel will increase to $0.38 from $0.19.
The World Bank has told Sao Tome, which is one of the poorest countries in the world and is heavily reliant on foreign aid, that its fuel prices must correspond to market prices.
Petrol prices are expected to rise to $1 per litre later this year.
